\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 207-208 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R211-first-pass-words-from-chapters-207-208}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a servant and a passer-by.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a clove, cardamom, cinnamon, black pepper, vinegar
  \item a nightingale, a crane, a vulture, a bat, a scorpion
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A clove? (\textbf{\ur{لونگ}}, \emph{laung}.) Cardamom? (\textbf{\ur{الائچی}}, \emph{ilāichī}.) Cinnamon? (\textbf{\ur{دارچینی}}, \emph{dārchīnī}.) Black pepper? (\textbf{\ur{کالی} \ur{مرچ}}, \emph{kālī mirch}.) Vinegar? (\textbf{\ur{سرکہ}}, \emph{sirkā}.) A nightingale? (\textbf{\ur{بلبل}}, \emph{bulbul}.) A crane? (\textbf{\ur{سارس}}, \emph{sāras}.) A vulture? (\textbf{\ur{گدھ}}, \emph{giddh}.) A bat? (\textbf{\ur{چمگادڑ}}, \emph{chamgādaṛ}.) A scorpion? (\textbf{\ur{بچھو}}, \emph{bichchhū}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 209-211 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R211-second-pass-words-from-chapters-209-211}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a banknote and a debt.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a banknote, a debt, a tax, a bill, an expense
  \item a barber, a washerman, a cobbler, a blacksmith, a carpenter
  \item a secretary, a manager, a class, a servant, a passer-by
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A banknote? (\textbf{\ur{نوٹ}}, \emph{noṭ}.) A debt? (\textbf{\ur{قرض}}, \emph{qarz}.) A tax? (\textbf{\ur{ٹیکس}}, \emph{ṭaiks}.) A bill? (\textbf{\ur{بل}}, \emph{bil}.) An expense? (\textbf{\ur{خرچ}}, \emph{kharch}.) A barber? (\textbf{\ur{نائی}}, \emph{nāī}.) A washerman? (\textbf{\ur{دھوبی}}, \emph{dhobī}.) A cobbler? (\textbf{\ur{موچی}}, \emph{mochī}.) A blacksmith? (\textbf{\ur{لوہار}}, \emph{lohār}.) A carpenter? (\textbf{\ur{بڑھئی}}, \emph{baṛhaī}.) A secretary? (\textbf{\ur{سیکرٹری}}, \emph{sekreṭarī}.) A manager? (\textbf{\ur{مینیجر}}, \emph{mainejar}.) A class? (\textbf{\ur{کلاس}}, \emph{klās}.) A servant? (\textbf{\ur{نوکر}}, \emph{naukar}.) A passer-by? (\textbf{\ur{راہگیر}}, \emph{rāhgīr}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
